author: KEXP
description: Boston-based band Fiddlehead deliver a potent set of post-hardcore in our latest in-studio session. The band offer buzzing guitar riffs, punchy rhythms, and personal songwriting through a live performance of "Heart To Heart" and more.
title: Fiddlehead performs "Heart To Heart" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
